declarations.name: AuiCalendarHeatmap

inputs.name: label
inputs.description: Chart title: visible text and the accessible name of the plot (aria-labelledby); also the data table caption.

inputs.name: hideLabel
inputs.description: Visually hide the title; it stays the accessible name.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Visible description below the title, also referenced by aria-describedby (text only).

inputs.name: summary
inputs.description: Replaces the generated accessible summary (date range, days with values, total, highest and lowest days, non-working days and holidays).

inputs.name: valueFormat
inputs.description: Number format for day values (tooltips, accessible names, legend, table, summary).

inputs.name: formatValue
inputs.description: Custom value text; overrides valueFormat everywhere.

inputs.name: theme
inputs.description: Look and feel: { palette?: string[] (1-8 CSS colors for slots 1-8); fontFamily?; fontSize? (8-32 px); textColor?; gridLines?: boolean; gridColor?; gridDash?; axisColor?; lineWidth?; markerSize?; cornerRadius?; barRadius?; cellRadius?; sliceRadius?; boxRadius?; swatchRadius?; tooltipRadius?; controlRadius?; lineJoin?; areaOpacity?; gradient?; valueLabelColor?; tooltip?: { background?, color?, borderColor? }; legendPosition?: 'top' | 'bottom' | 'start' | 'end'; animation?: boolean | { duration?: number } }. Applied as --aui-chart-* custom properties and classes on the host through the CSSOM (CSP-safe); colors are validated with CSS.supports('color'). Animation is opt-in and never runs with prefers-reduced-motion: reduce or [data-aui-animation='none'].

inputs.name: renderTooltip
inputs.description: Custom tooltip content as DOM nodes (never HTML strings). context: { title, rows: { label, value, seriesId }[], column, row, source: "pointer" | "focus" | "sync" }. Return null for the default tooltip. The tooltip stays aria-hidden; the focused mark keeps its accessible label.

inputs.name: syncGroup
inputs.description: Synchronized crosshair: charts with the same group show the highlight and tooltip at the same column (week index) when one is hovered or focused.

inputs.name: data
inputs.description: Days: { date: PlainDate; value: number | null } (null, NaN, and infinities are days without value; later duplicates replace earlier ones). At most 20,000 entries.

inputs.name: year
inputs.description: Show this calendar year (ignored when from and to are both set).

inputs.name: from
inputs.description: First day shown (inclusive). Default: January 1 of year, else the first data date.

inputs.name: to
inputs.description: Last day shown (inclusive), at most 1,097 days after from. Default: December 31 of year, else the last data date.

inputs.name: firstDayOfWeek
inputs.description: First row: ISO weekday 1 (Monday) to 7 (Sunday). Default: from the locale (getFirstDayOfWeek).

inputs.name: businessCalendar
inputs.description: Business calendar (createBusinessCalendar from @absoluteui/components/business-calendar): non-working days are outlined, holidays get a dot and their name in tooltips, accessible names, and the table.

inputs.name: colorScale
inputs.description: { color?: 1-8 (default 1), min?, max? (fixed domain; default the nice-rounded data extent), steps?: 3-9 (default 5) }. Values outside a fixed domain use the first or last step.

inputs.name: legend
inputs.description: Legend of the color steps with their ranges, "No value", and (with a business calendar) the non-working-day and holiday keys; auto and show both show it, hide removes it. Entries are not buttons.

inputs.name: dataTable
inputs.description: Data table fallback (one row per day: date, value, and (with a business calendar) the day type): behind a Show data table button (built on first open), always visible, visually hidden (screen readers only), or none.

inputs.name: tooltip
inputs.description: Tooltip on pointer hover and keyboard focus.

inputs.name: patterns
inputs.description: Shared chart option (toggles aui-chart--patterns); day squares are not textured, so it has no visible effect.

inputs.name: height
inputs.description: Plot height in CSS px (integer 120-2000); the width follows the container.

inputs.name: monthLabels
inputs.description: Month names above the first week of each month.

inputs.name: weekdayLabels
inputs.description: Weekday names beside the rows: auto (every other row), all, or none.

inputs.name: locale
inputs.description: Number, date, and message locale.

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: rtl puts the first week on the right and swaps ArrowLeft/ArrowRight.

models.name: hiddenSeries
models.description: Shared chart option; a calendar heatmap has no series, so it has no effect.

outputs.name: pointClicked
outputs.description: A day was activated: pointer click or tap, or Enter / Space on the focused day. label is the formatted date, column the week, row the weekday row, value the formatted value.

methods.name: setSeriesVisible
methods.description: Shared chart method; no effect beyond a re-render.

accessibility.pattern: SVG calendar grid as a named, described group (role="group" with aria-roledescription "calendar heatmap") of role="img" days with roving focus following the APG date grid keys (day and week); a legend of steps and day types; data table fallback.

limitations: Daily values only (PlainDate); no hourly breakdown.
Discrete sequential steps (3-9) of one palette slot.
